name: fmp_actively_trading
description:
List of symbols currently actively trading, from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/actively-trading-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
For today's volume leaders use fmp_most_active; for all listed symbols fmp_stock_list.
Example: {}
